neighbours.label: The word that completes a substitution contrast ('instead of', 'rather than'): the slot where one option replaces another, vs additive links ('as well as', 'and', 'along with')
fire: Many cooks now use olive oil instead of butter for frying.
The council chose to repair the bridge rather than replace it.
We took the train instead of the car to save money.
She prefers reading on paper rather than on a screen.
The firm hired local workers instead of outside contractors.
He decided to walk home rather than wait for the bus.
The recipe calls for honey instead of white sugar.
Our team focused on quality rather than speed this year.
quiet: Many cooks now use olive oil as well as butter for frying.
The council chose to repair the bridge and paint it.
We took the train along with our bikes to save money.
She enjoys reading on paper and on a screen.
The firm hired local workers along with outside contractors.
He decided to walk home and wait for the bus there.
The recipe calls for honey and white sugar.
Our team focused on quality and speed this year.

notes: Card: ' of' x15 (after instead/outside), ' than' x5 (after rather), 'need not', 'solely'. Probe: 'instead of' 0.661, 'outside of' 0.467, 'rather than' 0.383, 'solely' 0.265, 'need not' 0.222; 'as well as' 0.055, 'and' 0.017.
